title: On Describing the road in great detail
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：describe　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 describe 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the director ① described the road in great detail twice over, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② describes the road in great detail year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ describe the road in great detail at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ described the road in great detail before — a line in the poster for August 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Describing the road in great detail twice over, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ describe the place as a paradise year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Describe the place as a paradise at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ describes the place as a paradise twice over every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ described the road in great detail again when nobody else would.

⑩ To describe the road in great detail, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody describes the road in great detail year after year again and somebody must describe the road in great detail twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 描述（一般过去式 described the road in great detail：1991 年导演头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 描述（一般现在 describes the road in great detail：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 描述（不定式 to describe the road in great detail：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 描述（过去完成时 had described the road in great detail：1985 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 描述（动名词 describing the road in great detail 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 把…说成（describe the place as a paradise：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去把…说成把那地方说成天堂）
G. v. 把…说成（describe the place as a paradise：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 描述（后段两处：新来的演员照例 describes the place as a paradise，而母亲又一次 described the road in great detail）

items.q: described the road in great detail
describes the road in great detail
to describe the road in great detail
described the road in great detail before
describing the road in great detail
describe the place as a paradise year after year
describe the place as a paradise at once
describes the place as a paradise twice over
described the road in great detail again
to describe the road in great detail

answers.why: describe 意为“描述”，1991 年导演来回两遍描述把那条路讲得很细，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 described。
describe 意为“描述”，自那以后导演年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 describes。
describe 意为“描述”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯描述把那条路讲得很细”，此处为不定式 to describe the road in great detail。
describe 意为“描述”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人描述过，故用过去完成时 had described。
describe 意为“描述”，导演说“描述把那条路讲得很细这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 describing the road in great detail 作主语。
describe 意为“把…说成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去把…说成把那地方说成天堂”，should ever 之后用原形 describe the place as a paradise。
describe 意为“把…说成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻把…说成把那地方说成天堂（describe the place as a paradise at once），以后再也不要提起。
describe 意为“描述”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例把…说成把那地方说成天堂，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 describes。
describe 意为“描述”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍描述把那条路讲得很细，用一般过去式 described 叙述。
describe 意为“描述”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要描述把那条路讲得很细，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，导演来回两遍描述把那条路讲得很细；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（described the road in great detail）
多年以后，导演仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（describes the road in great detail）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯描述把那条路讲得很细这件事本身。（to describe the road in great detail）
早在 1985 年就有人描述把那条路讲得很细，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had described the road in great detail）
导演说过，来回两遍描述把那条路讲得很细这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（describing the road in great detail 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻把…说成把那地方说成天堂，以后再也不要提起。（describe the place as a paradise，祈使句）
answers: In 1991 the director described the road in great detail twice over, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the director still describes the road in great detail year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to describe the road in great detail at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had described the road in great detail long before 1998, and the line in the poster for August proves it.
Describing the road in great detail twice over, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Describe the place as a paradise at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 describe 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the director described the road in great detail twice over, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director describes the road in great detail year after year whenever the theatre asks.
Describing the road in great detail twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever describe the place as a paradise year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre describes the place as a paradise twice over every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother described the road in great detail again, and the theatre remembered that half.
